ruleDefinitions.name: Net WebClient Casing Anomalies
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell command line contents that include a suspicious abnormal casing in the Net.Webclient (e.g. nEt.WEbCliEnT) string as used in obfuscation techniques
